title: Spectra — Fourier Lab
description: A ten-mode interactive Fourier & DSP lab on a from-scratch FFT — now it doesn't just show the transform, it DESIGNS with it. Draw shapes redrawn by rotating vectors, build and HEAR spectra, filter noise in the frequency domain, read spectrograms, and — new — DESIGN digital filters on an interactive z-plane: drag poles and zeros by hand and watch magnitude, phase, group delay, impulse response and sound recompute live from a from-scratch bilinear transform (Butterworth, Chebyshev, FIR, biquad). Plus a Morlet wavelet vs STFT, a real 2-D image FFT, a phase-vocoder time-stretch/pitch-shift, a JPEG-lite DCT codec, and cepstral pitch detection. Deep-linkable; no math libraries.
